name: BGP.Exchange - Route Servers
notes:
BGP.Exchange is a Internet Exchange, by utilizing various partners and sponsors, peers/users/client can connect on their nearest Point of Press or locations and peer with other members on that location or via our routeserver.

BGP.Exchange as of 1st of Januari 2025 operates in 45 Locations, offering physical, local vlan and/or virtual connections where possible.

BGP.Exchange is a free non-profit that can exists by our many partners and sponsors:

 - we do not ask a membership fee
 - partners are allowed to ask setup fees or recurring fees for transport, crossconnects, vlans or physical connections.

IPv4 Sessions are only possible via RFC1918.
